items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: "All the musicians then, Chuck. When the musicians, I wouldn't know."

ctx.x: Well they're no fun anyway. Huh? They're no fun anyway. No.

They don't know what fun is. So, I used to, so, I used to, I used to be behind them, used to be behind, used to be behind all them color parades, man. And used to have me some fun. Go out to the millen boy, go out to the millen boy, walk out there, catch, catch Smokey Mara. Catch Smokey Mara, go out there and have me some fun. Go, go get, go get some, go get some crab, sit down there and eat and drink. So, we used to have good time, partner, I'm telling you the truth. The musicians, them time musicians was…
Oh, from away? Uh huh. Well, now Sidney Bechet, he used to be a long way away. All right, Sidney Bechet. He died in France.
